description: This PHP class defines the configuration model for projects within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It provides methods to retrieve, validate, save, and manipulate project configuration settings such as investment restrictions, watch status, campaign timing, and impact calculator activation.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: Represents the configuration settings for a specific project, including methods for management and validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific project, providing default values if none exist.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current configuration data before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to the database, updating or replacing existing entries.

methods.name: closeInvest
methods.description: Sets the no-investment flag to close funding for the project.

methods.name: openInvest
methods.description: Clears the no-investment flag to open funding.

methods.name: isInvestClosed
methods.description: Checks whether investment is currently closed for the project.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Marks a project as being watched by a user.

methods.name: unwatch
methods.description: Removes the watch status from a project.

methods.name: isWatched
methods.description: Checks if a project is being watched.

methods.name: isOneRound
methods.description: Determines if the project is configured for a single campaign round.

methods.name: showRewardsMosaic
methods.description: Checks if the rewards mosaic mode is enabled for the project.

methods.name: hideExhaustedRewards
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is set to hide exhausted rewards.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Adjusts project campaign timing, switching between first and second rounds based on current state.

methods.name: isImpactCalcActive
methods.description: Returns whether the impact calculator feature is activated.

methods.name: activateImpactCalculator
methods.description: Activates the impact calculator feature for the project configuration.

methods.name: deactivateImpactCalculator
methods.description: Deactivates the impact calculator feature.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the project (campaign or permanent).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the project type (campaign or permanent).

methods.name: isTypePermanent
methods.description: Returns true if the project is of type permanent.

methods.name: isTypeCampaign
methods.description: Returns true if the project is of type campaign.
